audio.text: How long is the line at the health center?

options: The health center is open on Saturday mornings too, I think.
It's moving fast; I was in and out in ten minutes.
My cousin works there as a nurse.
Yes, it's a really long line.

why.en: "How long" → how much waiting. A gives opening days; C changes the subject; D answers "Yes" to a "how long" question.
why.tr: "How long" → ne kadar bekleneceği. A açık olduğu günleri söylüyor; C konuyu değiştiriyor; D "how long" sorusuna "Yes" diyor.
why.es: "How long" → cuánto hay que esperar. A da los días de apertura; C cambia de tema; D responde "Yes" a una pregunta con "how long".
